name: io.github.cdalton713/obsidian-crud-mcp
description: Give AI agents access to your Obsidian vault via local files or a Remotely Save S3 bucket.

environmentVariables.description: Path to your Obsidian vault directory, or the local mirror folder in S3 mode
environmentVariables.name: VAULT_PATH

environmentVariables.description: S3 endpoint of the bucket Remotely Save syncs to (e.g. https://<account-id>.r2.cloudflarestorage.com). Enables S3 mode with S3_BUCKET
environmentVariables.name: S3_ENDPOINT

environmentVariables.description: S3 region (default 'auto', which Cloudflare R2 expects)
environmentVariables.name: S3_REGION

environmentVariables.description: Remote prefix, if one is set in Remotely Save
environmentVariables.name: S3_PREFIX

environmentVariables.description: How often to poll the bucket for changes, in seconds (default 30)
environmentVariables.name: S3_POLL_SECONDS

environmentVariables.description: Encrypts the persisted metadata index (paths, tags, links) at rest
environmentVariables.name: INDEX_PASSPHRASE

environmentVariables.description: Vault name for deep links and index storage
environmentVariables.name: VAULT_NAME

environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated extra Host/Origin values accepted in no-auth mode (e.g. '192.168.1.5,mybox.local'). Localhost is always allowed; ignored when MCP_AUTH_TOKEN is set.
environmentVariables.name: MCP_ALLOWED_HOSTS

environmentVariables.description: Public URL for OAuth callbacks (required when using a tunnel)
environmentVariables.name: BASE_URL

environmentVariables.description: Set to 'true' to disable all write tools (write_note, edit_note, delete_note, move_note). Useful when exposing the server to multiple AI clients.
environmentVariables.name: READ_ONLY

environmentVariables.description: Extra text appended to the MCP instructions string (the server-side system prompt). Use to bake vault-specific conventions (folder structure, naming rules, folders to avoid) so they apply across every MCP client.
environmentVariables.name: MCP_INSTRUCTIONS

environmentVariables.description: Path to a file whose contents are appended to the MCP instructions. Easier than MCP_INSTRUCTIONS for multi-line conventions. File wins if both are set.
environmentVariables.name: MCP_INSTRUCTIONS_FILE
